notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Give every pursuit a reason, an audience and a next action.
intro: A proposed growth workbench for Icreon: connect named-account research, reviewed content and sales follow-through to qualified enterprise opportunities.
queueIntro: Organize a digital-services pursuit around a concrete business question. Separate a website observation from a buyer-confirmed project and keep the sales owner visible.
workbenchIntro: Check whether an AI-assisted asset has a defined buyer, sourced claim, human reviewer and a useful next action before it enters a campaign.
firstBody: Translate account research into a useful digital-experience question, a targeted content brief and a tracked seller handoff. Count accepted opportunities separately from clicks.

fields.label: Buyer role and intended audience defined
Specific digital experience or commerce question
Next action matches the buyer journey
Sales owner and pursuit key assigned

rules.title: Define the audience
rules.next: Choose the buyer role and decision this asset should help. One asset cannot speak to every stakeholder equally.

rules.title: State the business question
rules.next: Use a concrete digital experience, commerce or data problem; avoid generic AI transformation claims.

rules.title: Attach the research
rules.next: Preserve the source and date behind the account context before using it for personalization.

rules.title: Review the asset with a person
rules.next: AI-generated copy needs editorial and account-context review before publication or outreach.

rules.title: Check the claims
rules.next: Remove unsupported outcomes, invented references and statements that overstate the evidence.

rules.title: Choose a useful next action
rules.next: Align the next step with the buyer’s stage, such as a diagnostic conversation or a relevant case discussion.

rules.title: Assign the pursuit owner
rules.next: Connect the asset to a known account and seller so replies and qualified interest have a destination.

ready.title: Ready for campaign review
ready.next: Audience, problem, evidence, review and next action are explicit. The sales owner can approve how this asset supports the pursuit.

metricsTitle: Keep content engagement and sales qualification distinct.
metricsIntro: Synthetic named-account cohorts connect an educational asset to held discovery and qualified work. Influenced pipeline is not automatically sourced pipeline.
metricsNotes: Attach a stable pursuit key and a consistent observation window to each content interaction.
Keep sourced, influenced and existing-relationship pipeline separate. Do not add them together as independent revenue.
Include human research and content production cost before treating channel spend as total acquisition cost.

experiments.name: Buyer-specific research brief
experiments.hypothesis: A concrete digital business question leads to more useful discovery.
experiments.treatment: Sourced buyer question and relevant diagnostic
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Sales-reviewed content handoff
experiments.hypothesis: A receiving seller can act faster when the content’s purpose is explicit.
experiments.treatment: Buyer, claim sources, next step and owner
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Learn the pursuit motion
roadmap.body: Align with the Marketing Head and sales on account tiers, buyer problems and qualification.
roadmap.measure: Accepted account briefs and shared stage definitions

roadmap.title: Build the content-to-sales path
roadmap.body: Create a sourced asset brief with human review and a stable pursuit key. Instrument replies and held discovery.
roadmap.measure: Asset use, response ownership and qualified conversations

roadmap.title: Improve by pipeline evidence
roadmap.body: Compare cohorts with sales and refine the content that supports genuine project discussions.
roadmap.measure: Qualified pipeline and clear attribution boundaries
